input.subject: Refund Fast Delivery
input.body: I opted for fast delivery for my PS5 order and paid an additional Rs.100 for expedited delivery to my address in Delhi. However, the order was delivered after 6 days, which appears to be the regular delivery timeline. Since I paid extra for fast delivery but did not receive the promised service, I would like to request a refund of the Rs.100 delivery charge. Please review my order and let me know the refund status.
